Fundraising expertise shaped by advisory and investment experience

Hedley Ventures is built on over a decade of experience spanning venture capital investment and corporate finance advisory. Founder and Managing Director Thomas Hudson previously led PwC’s Series A fundraising team, advising on more than 20 transactions with a combined value exceeding £100 million before becoming an Investment Director at the Scottish National Investment Bank.

A prize-winning Chartered Accountant with a senior network across the venture capital market, Thomas helps founders prepare and execute successful fundraises while strengthening the finance function required to scale.
